Booz Allen Hamilton describes itself as transforming missions with tomorrow's technologies to advance the country's most critical civil, defense, and national security priorities. It is a public company, traded under the ticker BAH, and its website centers on government and national security work rather than on commercial software offerings.

The site's main recent announcement is the completed acquisition of the Ultra I&C Mission Solutions business, which now operates as the commercial product and solutions component of Booz Allen's defense technology business. Booz Allen states that the two organizations' complementary capabilities in battle management, secure communications, encryption, and edge compute will accelerate delivery of interoperable, mission-ready technologies for national security.

The material available does not name specific AI products or services, and no litigation, MCP servers, or product listings are associated with the company in the facts on hand.
